title: hn_claim_extraction_v1
description: Extractor output for one document (story title + self-text + top comments). Granularity v1: a claim is an atomic, generalized proposition someone could agree or disagree with — not a doc-specific anecdote. Target 3-10 claims per doc; 0 is valid for content-free docs.

claim.description: Atomic declarative statement, present tense, self-contained (no 'this', 'the author', 'OP'). Generalized beyond the specific instance: 'Rust prevents memory-safety bug classes', not 'my Rust port fixed a segfault'.

concepts.description: Noun-phrase concept anchors of the claim (lowercase, singular). The co-occurrence graph is built over resolved claims; concepts aid clustering and audit.

quote.description: Shortest verbatim source snippet grounding the claim (for audit; optional).
